plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖 · FR-7032 · 十三个候选覆盖模 510510 的偶数类
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage · FR-7032 · Thirteen candidates cover even residues modulo 510510

brief.zh: 逐类复核 255255 个偶类，可按 1001 个一块分 255 块由内核求值。再避开 17 后得到 19 粗的候选。
brief.en: Verify all 255255 even residues, e.g. by kernel evaluation in 255 blocks of 1001. Excluding 17 as well gives a 19-rough candidate.
